questionText:

The protocol prohibited high-speed dynamic movements and rapid breath holds. Participants performed Tadasana, Katichakrasana, and Pavanmuktasana to stimulate abdominal peristalsis and lipid metabolism. Arrange the correct sequence of performing Matsyasana (Fish Pose) from start to finish:
(A) Lie flat on the back (supine) with legs extended straight or folded into Padmasana
(B) Place palms underneath the buttocks or thighs to support the lower back
(C) Press elbows into the floor, arch the dorsal chest upward, and rest the crown of the head lightly on the mat
(D) Hold the posture taking deep thoracic breaths, then gently lower the chest and release

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Matsyasana proceeds from supine setup to elbow-prop, thoracic arch with crown touching floor, and controlled release.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
